svg.title: FDAI on Azure Kubernetes Service
svg.desc: Operators authenticate with Microsoft Entra ID and use the Console on Azure Static Web Apps. Azure API Management routes browser requests to the Operator Service and Document Ingestion API on AKS. The cluster separates its managed API server, system and user node pools, five service Deployments, and CronJobs. Event Hubs carries schema-validated service events. PostgreSQL and document storage remain outside the cluster. Workload Identity and Key Vault keep service identities and secrets separate. Only the isolated Executor is eligible for approved resource effects. Container Registry supplies digest-pinned images; Azure OpenAI and monitoring are shared dependencies. This is a deployment profile, not live health or private-network evidence.
svg.text: The AKS deployment with a public authenticated console, five independent services, scheduled jobs, and shared Azure dependencies.
